title: Primer ID MiSeq Library Preparation
author: Shuntai Zhou
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.useewbe
materials: Complete thaw and vortex KAPA reagents (except for enzyme) before use.
Gel purification. (Qiagen QIAquick gel extraction kit) Run 2 nd round PCR products on 1.2% agarose gel. E = 4 V/cm, T = 60 min.
Quantification using Invitrogen Qubit dsDNA BR Assay kit. See Qubit dsDNA BR assay protocol. Don’t use Nanodrop to quantify!
Quantify the pooled library using Qubit dsDNA BR assay kit. Check the quality of the library by Agilent Bioanalyzer or Bio-rad Experion. Repeat purification if primer dimmer is present (~200bp).

steps.title: Prepare Primer Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10 µM primer mix for multiplexing sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Mix 10 µL of each primer in one set with 60 µL of dH2O.
Mix well.

steps.title: Perform First-Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA from the RNA template.

substeps.instruction: Pipette dNTPMix, cDNA primer, and RNA template into a 0.5 ml RNase-free tube.
Heat in a 65°C heat block for 3-5 minutes.
Add 5x buffer, DTT, RNaseOUT, and SSII RT.
Mix and incubate at 50°C for 1 hour.
Increase temperature to 55°C and incubate for 1 hour.
Inactivate SSIII RT by heating at 70°C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Digest RNA Template
steps.instruction: Remove the RNA template using RNase H.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 μl RNase H to each tube.
Incubate at 37°C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Purify cDNA with Agencourt RNAClean XP
steps.instruction: Purify the cDNA using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend Agencourt RNAClean XP beads (1ml aliquots) and let stand at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before use.
Transfer cDNA reactions into 1.7 mL RNase-free tubes.
Vortex beads and add 42 µl of beads to 60 µl cDNA (Ratio: 0.6 – 0.8).
Mix thoroughly by pipetting 15 times (do not vortex).
Incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Place on a magnetic tube rack for 5 minutes to separate beads.
Slowly aspirate and discard the cleared solution while the tube remains on the rack.
Dispense 500 μL of 70% ethanol, incubate for 30 seconds at room temperature, then aspirate and discard (repeat this wash twice).
Air-dry the tube on the rack with the cap open for 10 minutes until ethanol traces evaporate.
Remove from rack and resuspend beads in 24 µl DNase-free water by pipetting up and down.
Place tube back on the rack for 3 minutes.
Pipette the eluant from the tube while it is on the magnetic rack.

steps.title: Perform PCR1 Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the purified cDNA using a mastermix.

substeps.instruction: Prepare mastermix in a cold box containing 5x Buffer A, Enhancer, dNTPs, Forward primer, ADPT_2a, and KAPA Robust polymerase.
Use a repeater pipette to add mastermix to each tube in the cold box.
Add template cDNA to each tube and pipette up and down to mix.

steps.title: Purify PCR Products with AmpureXP
steps.instruction: Clean up PCR1 products using Ampure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend Ampure XP beads (1 ml aliquot) and let stand at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before use.
Transfer PCR1 reactions into 1.7 mL RNase-free tubes.
Add 40 µl Ampure XP beads to each reaction (Ratio: 0.6 – 0.8: 1, 36µl – 48µl).
Mix thoroughly by vortexing and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes (off the rack).
Place on a magnetic tube rack for 5 minutes.
Slowly aspirate and discard the cleared solution while on the rack.
Dispense 500 μL of 70% ethanol, incubate for 30 seconds at room temperature, then aspirate and discard (repeat this wash twice).
Air-dry the tube on the rack with the cap open for 10 minutes.
Remove from rack and resuspend beads in 50 µl DNase-free water by pipetting up and down.
Place tube back on the rack for 3 minutes.
Pipette 45 µl of eluant from the tube while on the magnetic rack.

steps.title: Perform Indexed PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the purified DNA with indexed adapters.

substeps.instruction: Prepare mastermix in a cold box containing 5x KAPA HiFi Fidelity Buffer, dNTP Mix, Uni Adapter (ADPT_P1), KAPA HiFI polymerase, and Water.
Add mastermix to tubes in the cold box using a repeater pipette.
Add Indexed Adapter and Purified template DNA to each tube.

steps.title: Gel Purification of Libraries
steps.instruction: Purify the indexed libraries using agarose gel electrophoresis and MinElute columns.

substeps.instruction: Run 2 µl of products on a 1% agarose gel to check bands.
Weight the gel and add 3 volumes of Buffer QG to 1 volume of gel.
Incubate at 50°C for 10 minutes to dissolve, vortexing every 2-3 minutes.
Verify the solution is yellow; if not, add 10 µl 3M sodium acetate.
Apply the sample to a MinElute column and centrifuge for 1 minute.
Add 500 µl Buffer QG and centrifuge for 1 minute.
Add 0.75 ml buffer PE, incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, and centrifuge for 1 minute.
Discard fluid and centrifuge for an additional 3 minutes.
Transfer the column to a new 1.7 ml tube, add 10 µl buffer EB, let stand for 4 minutes, and centrifuge for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Pool and Final Purify Libraries
steps.instruction: Pool the quantified libraries and perform a final cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Pool libraries in equal amounts after quantification.
Purify pooled libraries using AMPure XP beads (Ratio 2:3, two washes).
Elute in 20 to 30 µL Elution Buffer.
Place the tube on ice for 1 minute.
